1.title: Networking and Content Delivery
1.text: Welcome to Module ten: Networking and Content Delivery. This module covers task statement three point five, identifying the A W S network services. You will learn how a V P C is built, how firewalls and gateways control traffic, how D N S and content delivery work, and how to connect your own sites to A W S. The exam rarely goes deep here, but it expects you to match a need to the right service.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do five things. Describe the parts of an Amazon V P C: subnets, route tables and gateways. Compare security groups and network A C Ls. Explain what Amazon Route fifty-three and Amazon CloudFront do. Choose among Site-to-Site V P N, Client V P N and A W S Direct Connect. And place Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, Global Accelerator and A P I Gateway.

1.title: Case Check-In: Tidewater Builds Its Network
1.text: Tidewater is building the network for its shop. Customers must reach the web servers, but nobody on the internet may reach the database. Servers in the private network must download updates without accepting outside connections. Visitors type a domain name, and customers in Europe need fast page loads. The warehouse must connect securely to the cloud, and some staff work from home. Your job is to choose the network services.

1.title: Amazon VPC: Your Private Network in AWS
1.text: Amazon V P C lets you launch A W S resources in a logically isolated virtual network that you define. It resembles a traditional network in your own data center, with the scalability of A W S. In the figure, the V P C holds two Availability Zones, and each zone has a public subnet and a private subnet. A subnet is a range of I P addresses that lives entirely in one Availability Zone, so use subnets in several zones for resilience. Route tables decide where traffic goes, and gateways connect the V P C to other networks. Every Region starts with a default V P C. A V P C has no additional charge, but some parts, such as N A T gateways, do. Exam tip: a V P C is your isolated network, and each subnet lives in one Availability Zone.

1.title: Public and Private Subnets: Internet and NAT Gateways
1.text: The difference between public and private subnets comes down to routing. A public subnet has a route to an internet gateway, so resources with public I P addresses can reach the internet and be reached. Use it for web servers and load balancers. A private subnet has no direct route to an internet gateway. Use it for databases and application servers. The internet gateway is a redundant, highly available link between the V P C and the internet, and it has no charge. A N A T gateway lets instances in a private subnet reach out, while the internet cannot start a connection to them. Charges apply. A W S recommends private subnets to protect your resources. Exam tip: reach out but not be reached means N A T gateway; a direct internet path means internet gateway.

1.title: Security Groups and Network ACLs
1.text: A V P C has two firewall layers, and the exam asks you to compare them. A security group works at the resource, such as an E C two instance. A network A C L, or access control list, works at the subnet. Security groups use allow rules. Network A C Ls use allow and deny rules, checked in number order. Security groups are stateful, so replies to allowed traffic are allowed automatically. Network A C Ls are stateless, so replies need their own rule. In practice, the security group is the main firewall for each resource, and the network A C L is an extra layer; the default one allows all traffic. Amazon Inspector also checks for unintended network exposure, as Module five explained. Exam tip: stateful and per resource means security group; stateless, per subnet, with deny rules means network A C L.

1.title: Amazon Route 53: DNS and Health Checks
1.text: Amazon Route fifty-three is a highly available, scalable D N S web service. It does three jobs. Domain registration: register names such as example dot com. D N S routing: connect a browser that types your domain to your website or application. And health checking: send automated requests to confirm a resource is reachable, notify you, and route traffic away from unhealthy resources. Traffic Flow adds routing by latency, geoproximity and health, and the V P C Resolver answers D N S queries inside your V P Cs. Exam tip: domain names and D N S routing mean Amazon Route fifty-three.

1.title: Amazon CloudFront: Faster Delivery Worldwide
1.text: Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network, a C D N, that speeds up static and dynamic web content. It delivers from edge locations, and each request goes to the one with the lowest latency. If the object is not in the cache, that is a cache miss, and CloudFront fetches it from your origin, such as an Amazon S three bucket or an H T T P server. Objects stay cached for twenty-four hours by default, and you can change that. You create a distribution to tell CloudFront where your content comes from. You pay for data transfer out and for requests, while data from A W S origins into CloudFront is free. Exam tip: delivering web content quickly to users worldwide means Amazon CloudFront.

1.title: Your Network to AWS: VPN and Direct Connect
1.text: To connect your own network to A W S, you have three options. A W S Site-to-Site V P N is an encrypted I P sec connection between your network and your V P C, over the internet, with two tunnels per connection. A W S Client V P N is a managed, client-based V P N, where individual users connect from anywhere with an Open V P N-based client. A W S Direct Connect is a dedicated network connection from your site to A W S, bypassing internet service providers. It bills port hours and outbound data transfer. In the figure, the encrypted tunnel travels over the internet, while the dedicated line does not. Exam tip: encrypted over the internet means V P N; a dedicated private line means A W S Direct Connect.

2.title: Transit Gateway, PrivateLink and Global Accelerator
2.text: Three more networking services are in scope. A W S Transit Gateway is a network transit hub that interconnects V P Cs and on-premises networks through attachments. Think of it as many networks, one hub. A W S PrivateLink privately connects your V P C to services as if they were in it, with no internet gateway, N A T device or public I P address. Think of it as private access to services. A W S Global Accelerator gives you two static I P addresses, and routes users over the A W S global network to the best healthy endpoint. Think of it as global performance and failover. Exam tip: a hub for networks means Transit Gateway; private service access means PrivateLink; static I P addresses and global routing mean Global Accelerator.

2.title: Amazon API Gateway: The Front Door for APIs
2.text: Amazon A P I Gateway creates, publishes, maintains, monitors and secures A P Is at any scale. It supports rest, H T T P and WebSocket A P Is. It acts as a front door to backends such as A W S Lambda, Amazon E C two, or any web application. It handles traffic management, authorization, access control, monitoring and version management. Authentication options include I A M policies, Lambda authorizers and Amazon Cognito user pools, and A W S W A F can protect your A P Is from common web exploits. Together with Lambda, it forms the app-facing part of serverless applications. Exam tip: publishing and securing A P Is in front of Lambda or other backends means Amazon A P I Gateway.

2.title: What the Exam Asks: Networking
2.text: Here is how the exam frames networking. Public or private subnet: a route to an internet gateway, or none. Internet gateway or N A T gateway: a direct path, or reach out only. Security group or network A C L: stateful per resource, or stateless per subnet. Route fifty-three or CloudFront: D N S and health checks, or cached content at the edge. V P N or Direct Connect: encrypted over the internet, or a dedicated line. Transit Gateway, PrivateLink or Global Accelerator: a hub, private access, or static global I P addresses. And A P I Gateway: a front door for A P Is. Exam tip: name the layer first: network, firewall, D N S, delivery, connection or A P I.

2.title: Design Check: Tidewater's Network Plan
2.text: Now a design check. Cover the right column and answer each row yourself. Web servers reachable, database not reachable: public and private subnets. Private servers that download updates: a N A T gateway. Allow only web traffic, with replies automatic: a security group. Block one bad I P range at the subnet edge: a network A C L with a deny rule. Customers type the shop's domain name: Amazon Route fifty-three. Fast page loads in Europe: Amazon CloudFront. A quick, encrypted warehouse link: Site-to-Site V P N. A dedicated line to the warehouse: A W S Direct Connect. And staff working from home: A W S Client V P N. Pause the video if you want more time.

2.title: Try It: A VPC with Public and Private Subnets (Optional)
2.text: This optional exercise is not tested on the exam, but it makes the network pieces concrete. Use a practice account. A V P C itself is free, but N A T gateways are not, so avoid creating them. In the V P C console, choose Create V P C, then V P C and more, with two Availability Zones, public and private subnets, and no N A T gateways. Open the route tables, and notice that only the public one has a route to the internet gateway. Look at the security group and network A C L that the wizard created. The command on the screen lists the V P C I Ds in the current Region. When you finish, clean up by deleting the V P C. Exam tip: hands-on work is not tested on this exam, but it makes the network pieces concrete.

2.title: Module Recap
2.text: Here is the recap. A V P C is an isolated network. Subnets live in one Availability Zone, and public subnets route to an internet gateway. For gateways, use an internet gateway for a direct path, and a N A T gateway for outbound-only access. For firewalls, security groups are stateful and per resource, and network A C Ls are stateless and per subnet. For D N S and delivery, Route fifty-three handles domains and health checks, and CloudFront serves cached content at the edge. For connections, Site-to-Site V P N runs over the internet, Client V P N is for users, and Direct Connect is a dedicated line. The others are Transit Gateway as a hub, PrivateLink for private access, Global Accelerator for static I P addresses, and A P I Gateway for A P Is.

2.title: Practice Question 1
2.text: Question one. Which V P C feature acts as a stateful firewall for an E C two instance, automatically allowing the replies to traffic that it permits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C, a security group. It is a stateful virtual firewall for resources such as E C two instances, so replies to allowed traffic are permitted automatically. A network A C L is stateless and works at the subnet level, and N A T and internet gateways route traffic rather than filter it.

2.title: Practice Question 2
2.text: Question two. Tidewater's application servers are in a private subnet. They must download software updates from the internet, but the internet must not be able to start connections to them. What should Tidewater add? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A, a N A T gateway in a public subnet, with a route from the private subnet. It lets instances in a private subnet reach the internet while the internet cannot start connections to them. A direct route to the internet gateway or public I P addresses would make the servers reachable, and allowing all inbound traffic does the same.

2.title: Practice Question 3
2.text: Question three. Which A W S service is a highly available D N S web service that can register domain names, route internet traffic to resources and check their health? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D, Amazon Route fifty-three. It performs domain registration, D N S routing and health checking. CloudFront caches content at edge locations, Global Accelerator routes traffic over the A W S network to endpoints, and A P I Gateway manages A P Is.

2.title: Practice Question 4
2.text: Question four. Tidewater wants its images, scripts and pages delivered quickly to customers worldwide by caching them near the customers. Which service should it use? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B, Amazon CloudFront. It is a content delivery network that caches static and dynamic content at edge locations, and serves each request from the lowest-latency one. Direct Connect, a N A T gateway and Transit Gateway connect networks rather than deliver cached content.

2.title: Practice Question 5
2.text: Question five. Select two. Which two statements about connecting an on-premises network to A W S are correct? The five options are on the screen. The answers are A and C. Site-to-Site V P N carries encrypted I P sec tunnels over the internet, while Direct Connect is a dedicated connection that bypasses internet service providers. Client V P N connects individual users rather than data centers, and only Direct Connect needs a dedicated connection.

2.title: Answers at a Glance
2.text: Here are all five answers. Question one: C. Question two: A. Question three: D. Question four: B. Question five: A and C. That completes Module ten. Next, Module eleven covers machine learning and analytics services.
